A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Vocal coaching session
services.story: The main story: a $90 vocal coaching session (one hour, one to one). A $30 deposit now, and the $60 rest at the studio.

services.name: Instrument lesson
services.story: A $40 instrument lesson (30 minutes). A card is saved for the studio's $20 fee. Alex pays at the studio.

services.name: Instrument lesson
services.story: A $40 instrument lesson for a returning student. Nothing is taken: a YES books it.

services.name: Private coaching
services.story: A $75 private coaching session (one hour), paid in full when booking.

services.name: Custom arrangement
services.story: A custom arrangement priced from the song list at $90. A card is saved for the $20 fee. Booked once the studio OKs it, and paid at the studio.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Party band
services.story: The main story: a 3-hour birthday party, quoted from Alex's plan at $1,500 (over Sam's $500, so Sam OKs it). Both sign the contract. A $375 deposit holds the date, and the $1,125 rest goes on the saved card at DONE.

services.name: Party band
services.story: A company event, quoted from the plan at $1,500 (over $500, so Sam OKs it). Both sign the contract, a $375 deposit holds the date, and the rest, with any overtime, goes on the bill after.

services.name: Small event duo
services.story: A $450 small event duo (2 hours). A $100 deposit now, and the $350 rest on the saved card at DONE.

services.name: Small event duo
services.story: The $450 small event duo, paid in full when booking.

questions_before_times: The kind of event: a party, a wedding, a company event, a bar night or a small event
The date, and the start and end time
The venue's name and town (for the travel fee), and indoors, outdoors or both
About how many guests (it sets the sound and the set length)
The players wanted: a full band, a duo, or a solo singer
Add-ons: a second set, extra players, sound hire, ceremony music
At the studio: the lesson, the instrument and the level, or the custom arrangement's song
safety_stop: Someone hurt, a fire, or a fight at the venue right now
license: None for band work or music lessons in most places. A local business license where the city or county asks for one: from the state form.
staff_skills: ["Weddings and ceremony music (leads only)","Parties and company events","Kids' parties","Sound hire","Lessons","Custom arrangements"]
messages_never: Gate codes, access notes, a child's details and family notes stay on the secure page. The do-not-play list and the set list stay on the set list form. Texts to the band carry none of them either.
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
